model_output.verdict: The Cobalt Pay role is an engineering management job, and your resume shows field operations leadership rather than backend engineering. I’d pass for this role because I can’t see the engineering experience it requires. Your progression at Northstar is worth a closer look for operations leadership jobs.
write_up: Cobalt Pay is looking for someone to lead backend engineers on payouts and the ledger. Your resume tells a different story: you moved from appliance repair operations to leading field operations at Northstar Home Services. It’s common for an operations resume to list areas of responsibility, but this one doesn’t yet show enough of the work behind those responsibilities to stand out for senior operations jobs either.

Your line about partnering with Finance on the annual operating plan works because it names both a partner and a concrete piece of work. Your experience comes before Education, and the progression at Northstar is easy to follow. What’s missing is how large your remit is and what changed under your leadership.

Let’s start with your current role. Add the team and budget figures you can substantiate to the field operations line, then name an initiative you led and what it changed. For Cobalt Pay, add engineering experience only if you have it; the operations work alone doesn’t establish the required technical background.
